scenes.text: This steak is so rich, the fat melts in your hand.
It's Japanese A5 wagyu, the highest grade of beef on Earth.
Inspectors score the marbling, those white ribbons of fat, from one to twelve.
Real Kobe beef comes only from Hyogo, Japan, and every cut is tracked.
The fat melts at a lower temperature than normal beef, so it dissolves on your tongue.
One steak can cost hundreds of dollars. Would you try it? Follow for more.
